text:
Predicates:
City(x) ::: x is a city.
State(x) ::: x is a state.
In(x, y) ::: x is in y.
SameState(x, y) ::: x and y are in the same state.
US ::: the United States.
Montana ::: the state of Montana.
Butte ::: the city of Butte.
Helena ::: the city of Helena.
Missoula ::: the city of Missoula.
WhiteSulphurSprings ::: the city of White Sulphur Springs.
StPierre ::: the city of St Pierre.
Bismarck ::: the city of Bismarck.
Bristol ::: the city of Bristol.
Texarkana ::: the city of Texarkana.
Texhoma ::: the city of Texhoma.
UnionCity ::: the city of UnionCity.
Premises:
City(Billings) ∧ In(Billings, Montana) ∧ State(Montana) ::: Billings is a city in the state of Montana in U.S.
State(Montana) ∧ City(Butte) ∧ City(Helena) ∧ City(Missoula) ∧ In(Butte, Montana) ∧ In(Helena, Montana) ∧ In(Missoula, Montana) ::: The state of Montana includes the cities of Butte, Helena, and Missoula.
City(WhiteSulphurSprings) ∧ City(Butte) ∧ In(WhiteSulphurSprings, Montana) ::: White Sulphur Springs and Butte are cities in the same state in U.S.
City(StPierre) ∧ ¬In(StPierre, Montana) ::: The city of St Pierre is not in the state of Montana.
∀x (City(x) ∧ In(x, Butte) → ¬In(x, StPierre)) ::: Any city in Butte is not in St Pierre.
∀x ∀y ∀z ∀w ((City(x) ∧ State(y) ∧ State(z) ∧ y ≠ z ∧ In(x, y) ∧ In(x, z)) → (x = Bristol ∨ x = Texarkana ∨ x = Texhoma ∨ x = UnionCity)) ::: A city can only be in one state in U.S. except for Bristol, Texarkana, Texhoma and Union City.
Conclusion:
SameState(StPierre, Bismarck) ::: St Pierre and Bismarck are in the same state.
